privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.subheading: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how we handle your data with care.
privacy.description: At Resomix, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our service.
privacy.information_we_collect_1: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.information_we_collect_2: Audio files that you upload to our service
privacy.information_we_collect_3: Feedback and survey responses you provide
privacy.information_we_collect_4: Usage data and analytics about how you interact with our service
privacy.information_we_collect_5: We Technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and device information
privacy.how_we_use_2: Provide and improve our music recommendation services
privacy.how_we_use_3: Analyze musical patterns and features in uploaded tracks
privacy.how_we_use_5: Communicate with you about our services
privacy.how_we_use_6: Monitor and analyze usage patterns and trends
privacy.data_retention_1: We retain your uploaded audio files and associated data for as long as necessary to provide our services. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.data_security_1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.
privacy.your_rights_1: Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:
privacy.your_rights_5: Object to or restrict processing of your information
privacy.changes_to_policy_1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.contact_us_1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at
